# Paths whose change turns the slow tier on for a pull request (R-CMD-check.yaml,
# "Decide tier"). One extended regular expression per line, matched against
# each changed file's path from the repository root. Lines starting with # and
# blank lines are ignored.
^R/pipeline-fit\.R$
^R/fit-(single-config|uq|warmstart)\.R$
^R/pipeline-evaluate\.R$
^R/evaluate-single-config\.R$
^R/monitor-evaluate\.R$
^R/utils-(parallel|resamples|recipes)\.R$
^R/pipeline-select-training\.R$
^R/select-[a-z]+\.R$
^R/(ad|ensemble-[a-z]+|pipeline-ensemble)\.R$
^R/step-[a-z-]+\.R$
^tests/testthat/helper-.*\.R$
^tests/testthat/fixtures/
^tests/testthat\.R$
^DESCRIPTION$
^\.github/
